title: Precision-weighted regression detection & phase-gate rollout PRD for Optimize
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Define a precision-weighted, multi-signal regression detection system and phase-gate rollout for Optimize so model changes can be validated automatically against production-like prompt bundles with explicit decision rules for hold, rollback, or progressive rollforward.
background: Recent Optimize rollouts exposed two failure modes: (1) small but actionable quality regressions in underrepresented prompt slices and (2) excessive false-positive alerts from single noisy signals. Current gating relies on simple absolute thresholds and manual triage. This PRD proposes a composite signal approach that: weights signals by customer impact and signal fidelity, enforces per-cohort minimum detectable deltas, and codifies a phase-gated rollout with automatic hard/soft stop actions.
goals: 1) Reduce undetected regressions in low-volume but high-impact cohorts. 2) Reduce analyst time spent on false-positive alerts by 40%. 3) Ensure rollouts have clear, reproducible stop/rollback criteria tied to measurable signals.
out_of_scope: Model training changes, model architecture research, billing changes, or rewriting the evaluation harness. Integration with external customer dashboards (beyond links) is out of scope for this ticket.
requirements: Define composite quality score (CQS) computed from weighted sub-signals (accuracy/acceptance, hallucination rate, coherence, latency). Weights configurable per-customer cohort.
Specify minimum detectable delta (MDD) per metric and per-cohort given sample sizes; tie sampling to power targets (default 80% power, one-sided alpha 0.05).
Implement phase-gate rollout stages with automated wait windows and signal checks: Canary (1%), Small (10%), Ramp (50%), Full (100%).
Introduce two-action stop logic: Soft stop (pause ramp, notify on-call, require triage) and Hard stop (rollback to previous pinned model).
Create an 'alert budget' concept: allowable false-positive budget per release (e.g., 3 soft stops per release) and cost-weighted penalties for customer-impactful regressions.
Expose a policy config UI in Console for per-project signal weights, MDD targets, and canary sizing.
signal_spec: Primary signals: composite CQS (primary), human-annotated accuracy on stratified prompt sample, safety sentiment score (safety), latency P95 (latency).
Secondary signals: embedding drift (cosine change), token regression (n-gram novelty), top-k answer divergence vs. control model.
Signal fidelity tiers: high-fidelity (human labels, production QA), medium (automatic heuristics with tuned thresholds), low (statistical proxies). System should weight accordingly.
Weighting defaults: accuracy 0.45, safety 0.30, coherence 0.15, latency 0.10. Weights overrideable per-customer.
sampling_spec: Prompt bundles: each run uses a bundled control set (stable baseline) + stress slices. Control set sampled by stratification: user_intent (chat/assistant/query), token_length (short/medium/long), domain (support/commerce/generic).
Cohorts: define customer_cohort, endpoint_type, and latency_sensitive cohort. Each cohort must meet minimum sample count derived from MDD math before signals are trusted.
Sampling cadence: continuous streaming sampling with weekly aggregated evaluation windows and 24h fast-signal windows for latency and safety alerts.
Minimum samples per cohort for MDD: default 400 examples for quality metrics (supports 1.5 percentage point absolute delta detection at 80% power).
ab_criteria: Primary test: one-sided noninferiority for CQS with margin = 2.0 percentage points, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8. Failure to demonstrate noninferiority triggers soft stop.
Cohort checks: each defined cohort must pass noninferiority with its own MDD-adjusted margin. If any high-impact cohort fails, escalate to hard stop.
Multiple-comparison control: apply Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control at 0.10 across cohort tests for action decisions.
Decision rule combinator: actions determined by weighted sum of standardized z-scores across signals; default action thresholds documented in regression_thresholds.
regression_thresholds: Soft-stop conditions: CQS decrease >= 1.5 percentage points (absolute) on control set OR safety sentiment drop with >0.5 percentage point increase in 'unsafe' labels in 24h window OR latency P95 increase >= 20% AND exceeds 100ms absolute increase.

Hard-stop conditions: CQS decrease >= 3.0 percentage points on any high-impact cohort OR any safety-critical classifier triggered on >= 0.2% of requests above baseline OR user-reported severity > high (manual input) correlated with automatically-detected regression.
Noise floor: ignore single-signal blips that do not persist across two consecutive monitoring windows (24h windows) unless safety classifier crosses hard threshold.
Minimum sample requirement: thresholds apply only when cohort sample count >= MDD; otherwise flag as 'insufficient data' and require human review.
rollback_playbook: Soft stop (automatic): Pause next ramp step, create incident ticket, notify PM/Eng/On-call, run expanded diagnostics (detailed prompt-level diff), require human triage within 4 hours. If triage identifies root cause as model regression, proceed to hard stop.

Hard stop (automatic): Trigger rollback to last pinned model; roll back immediately for customer-impactful cohorts, schedule phased rollback for low-impact cohorts; notify affected customers via subscribed channels.
Post-rollback: run a post-mortem within 3 business days, preserve sampled prompts and model outputs for at least 90 days, and create follow-up action items with owners and SLAs.
Escalation: if rollback fails or model pin unavailable, execute fallback routing (route affected requests to compatible cheaper-tier model or region) and engage SRE runbook.
acceptance_criteria: Automated composite signal computation (CQS) implemented and documented in the eval harness, with weights configurable per-project in Console.
Sampling pipeline provides stratified control + stress slices and enforces MDD logic; dashboards show per-cohort sample counts and MDD status.
Automated phase-gate rollout controller that enforces wait windows and evaluates ab_criteria before allowing each ramp step; controller emits audit logs for each decision.
Soft-stop and hard-stop actions are automated and tested in a dry-run environment; end-to-end tests for both stop flows exist in CI with mock signals.
Dashboards: per-release page showing CQS trend, cohort-level breakdowns, active stops, and link to last incident analysis.
monitoring_dashboards: Optimize - Release CQS Overview (owned by PM team): trend lines, per-signal z-scores, and weight breakdown.
Optimize - Cohort Health: sample counts, MDD status, per-cohort CQS, and alerts.
Optimize - Canary Timeline: canary progress, step timestamps, stop events, and rollback actions.
